newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Romania PM arrives in Hungary for first visit.
newsitem.headline: Romania PM arrives in Hungary for first visit.

text.p: Romanian prime minister Victor Ciorbea arrived in Budapest on Wednesday on his first official visit abroad, set to seal the warming relations between the two ex-communist neighbours.
Ciorbea, accompanied by key ministers of his centrist coalition government, was given red-carpet treatment by his Hungarian counterpart, Prime Minister Gyula Horn.
Horn met Ciorbea at the Hungarian parliament building, with a military honour guard in attendance.
Hungary and Romania are expected to sign accords on boosting economic cooperation to coordinate foreign policy moves during Ciorbea's two-day visit.

The two countries signed a post-communist treaty last year ending disputes over ethnic minorities and borders, and have promised to work together for both to be included in the first enlargement of NATO, on which a decision is expected in July.
